title: ONLINE-TICS: Internet-Delivered Behavioral Treatment for Patients with Chronic Tic Disorders
newness: Historical 2022 publication newly analyzed on 14 October 2026; not new-window evidence.
design: Five-center observer-blind randomized adult trial; self-directed internet CBIT versus online psychoeducation; face-to-face CBIT available at one center.
population: Ages 18–62 with TS/chronic tic disorders; German/internet eligibility; prior behavioral treatment and comorbidity needing primary therapy excluded; not a defined continuously severe adult cohort.
primary_endpoint: Adjusted YGTSS-TTS change at one week after treatment, iCBIT minus control.
key_result: Primary −1.28 points (95% CI −2.58 to 0.01), p=.053. Later exploratory TTS contrasts favor iCBIT at three/six months; impairment and GTS-QOL have distinct timing. Non-inferiority is exploratory because the prespecified primary gate failed.
uncertainty: MAR-dependent mixed model, differential noncompliance, missing visit/outcome-specific denominators, continued platform access, multiple exploratory tests, and ATQ/impairment table–prose discrepancies.
negative_findings: No clear vocal-tic contrast; video-tic V3/V5 intervals include zero. Early urge and life-satisfaction VAS contrasts point unfavorably under standard scoring; trial VAS recoding unverified. CGI-I responder model failed to converge.
safety: 128 incidents, none investigator-attributed to treatment; event counts differ from affected-participant counts; rare harms remain unestablished.
funding_conflicts: BMBF 01KG1421 and EUR 600 advocacy funding; intervention developers among investigators; multiple financial relationships disclosed in paper.
inference_not_supported: Confirmatory primary efficacy/non-inferiority, endpoint surrogacy, joint response, increasing treatment effect, off-treatment durability, disease modification or cure.
reproducible_analysis: Nine-contrast post hoc Holm/Bonferroni sensitivity retains four of six nominally favorable focal contrasts; 33 checks independently reproduced. Not study-wide or confirmatory adjustment.
retrieval_status: Institutional version-of-record PDF text, protocol and official registry API inspected; screenshots failed. Original summaries/aggregates only saved.
correction_retraction_check: No identified correction/retraction in limited exact-identifier/source check; publisher 429 prevents comprehensive clearance.
next_verification_task: Audit adult-dominant Wilhelm 2012 follow-up estimand, response-conditioned participation and boosters; preserve inclusion of ages 16–17 and stop adult-only inference without subgroup data.
